
```{r}
n <- 900000  # Number of simulations
c <- 2  # Constant

# Initializing variables
accepted_x <- numeric(0)
accepted_y <- numeric(0)

# Acceptance-Rejection Method
for(i in 1:n){
  x <- runif(1, 0, 1)
  y <- runif(1, 0, 1)
  
  u <- runif(1, 0, 1)
  
  if(u <= (x + y) / c){
    accepted_x <- c(accepted_x, x)
    accepted_y <- c(accepted_y, y)
  }
}

# Calculations
E_Y <- mean(accepted_y)
var_X <- var(accepted_x)
E_XY <- mean(accepted_x * accepted_y)
E_X <- mean(accepted_x)
corr_XY <- cor(accepted_x, accepted_y)

# Output the results
cat("E[Y] =", E_Y, "\n")
cat("var[X] =", var_X, "\n")
cat("E[XY] =", E_XY, "\n")
cat("E[X] =", E_X, "\n")
cat("corr(X, Y) =", corr_XY, "\n")
```
